en: Correctness renders the same markdown with both implementations and compares the output byte for byte after a minimal normalization (attribute order; wrapper markup and generated ids only where both sides emit them by design). For variants without a custom renderer, the parsed token streams are compared as well — token metadata such as source maps is part of the public contract for plugins that build on top of these tokens. Every remaining difference is documented with a reason.

Benchmark throughput and scaling numbers are medians of interleaved samples, so both sides run in the same process under the same load. Corpora are committed markdown files: `normal` is a realistic document with sparse syntax, `heavy` is dense plugin syntax; each is measured at three sizes.

The test suite comparison runs each compared package's own unit tests against the reference implementation by swapping the built package entry for the reference package. Tests that only assert internal implementation details the reference does not provide are skipped with a reason and are not counted; every other failing test is a behavior difference between the two packages.
Scaling exponents are fitted on log-log axes: ~1 is linear and ~2 is quadratic. The series are built to expose the known superlinear paths of the reference implementations.

Package size covers the files published to npm: `dist/**`, `README`, `LICENSE*`, `package.json`, plus any extra file listed in the package `files` field. The reference size is the installed package directory without nested `node_modules`.
Entry gzip is the gzipped size of the ESM entry: the resolved `exports` entry for the current package and the `module` / `exports.import` / `main` entry for the reference.
zh: 正确性对比会用两个实现渲染同一段 Markdown，并在最小化归一化（属性顺序；仅当双方都按设计输出包裹标记和生成 id 时才归一化这些内容）后逐字节比较输出；对于未使用自定义渲染器的变体，还会比较解析后的 token 流——源码映射等 token 元数据对基于这些 token 的下游插件属于公共契约。其余每一处差异都会附带原因说明。
基准性能与复杂度缩放数据为交错采样结果的中位数，因此两侧在同一进程、相同负载下运行。语料为仓库提交的 markdown 文件：`normal` 是语法较稀疏的真实文档，`heavy` 是语法密集的文档；每种语料在三个规模下测量。
测试套件对比会把每个包的单元测试直接跑在参考实现上（用参考包替换插件入口）。只断言参考实现不存在的内部实现细节的测试会被标记为跳过并注明原因，不计入统计；其余失败测试都代表两个包之间的行为差异。
拟合指数基于对数坐标计算：约 1 为线性增长，约 2 为二次增长。各缩放系列针对参考实现已知的超线性路径设计。
包体积按发布到 npm 的文件计算：`dist/**`、`README`、`LICENSE*`、`package.json`，以及包 `files` 字段中列出的其他文件。参考包体积为已安装包目录的大小，不包含嵌套的 `node_modules`。
入口 gzip 为 ESM 入口 gzip 后的大小：本包为 `exports` 解析出的入口，参考包为 `package.json` 中的 `module` / `exports.import` / `main` 入口。

note.en: The reference delimiter check has no word-boundary rule, so it parses `a$x$b` as inline math; the current package requires a word boundary around `$` so that currency amounts stay literal (see `plain-dollar-currency`).
note.zh: 参考包的定界符检查没有单词边界规则，因此会把 `a$x$b` 解析为行内公式；当前包要求 `$` 两侧满足单词边界，以免货币金额被当作公式（见 `plain-dollar-currency`）。

note.en: An unclosed `$$` block is still emitted as display math by the reference: its `math_block` rule scans to the end of the document and then pushes the token anyway. The current package only starts a block when the closing `$$` exists and otherwise falls back to a paragraph.
note.zh: 未闭合的 `$$` 块仍会被参考包输出为显示公式：其 `math_block` 规则扫描到文档末尾后仍推入该 token。当前包只在存在结束 `$$` 时才开启块，否则回退为段落。

note.en: The reference parses `$$a=1$$ and $b=2$` as one display-math block that swallows the trailing inline expression; the current package keeps the line as a paragraph and renders `$b=2$` as inline math.
note.zh: 参考包把 `$$a=1$$ and $b=2$` 解析为一个吞掉尾部行内表达式的显示公式块；当前包保持整行为段落，并把 `$b=2$` 渲染为行内公式。

note.en: `$a\\$b`: the reference counts the preceding backslash run differently and closes the math after the escaped backslash (`\\` then `$`), while the current package treats a `$` preceded by an even number of backslashes as escaped and keeps the line literal.
note.zh: `$a\\$b`：参考包对前置反斜杠数量的计算方式不同，会在转义反斜杠之后闭合公式（先 `\\`，再 `$`），而当前包把前面有偶数个反斜杠的 `$` 视为已转义，整行保持字面量。

note.en: The reference stops scanning at the whitespace-surrounded `$` inside `\text{…}` and leaves the whole line literal; the current package treats that `$` as literal TeX content, keeps scanning to the final `$` and renders an error node.
